in_marathi.name: Sanjeev
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victorious, Victor, Conqueror
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanjeev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sanjeev is a name of Indian origin. This name means 'Victorious' or 'Conqueror'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sanjiva' which means 'victory' or 'life'. This name is believed to bring prosperity, victory, and courage to the bearer.
